operations.description: Create a DRAFT document from a UTF-8 text file with optional recipients, fields and meta (POST /api/v2/document/create, multipart).
Delete a document: drafts are removed, sent documents are cancelled and hidden (POST /api/v2/document/delete).
Send a DRAFT document to its recipients (synthetic; no e-mail is sent) (POST /api/v2/document/distribute).
Duplicate a document as a new DRAFT with fresh recipient links and empty fields (POST /api/v2/document/duplicate).
Find documents in the caller's team with search, status/source/template filters and page-number pagination (GET /api/v2/document).
Get a document with its synthetic text content, meta, recipients and fields (GET /api/v2/document/{documentId}).

operations.description: Resend signing requests to unsigned recipients of a PENDING document (synthetic) (POST /api/v2/document/redistribute).
Update a document's title, external id, visibility, global auth options or meta (POST /api/v2/document/update).
Page through a document's audit log by envelope id (GET /api/v2/envelope/{envelopeId}/audit-log).
Cancel a PENDING document by envelope id (POST /api/v2/envelope/cancel).
Place fields for recipients on a document's pages (POST /api/v2/document/field/create-many).
Delete an uninserted field (POST /api/v2/document/field/delete).
Get a document field (GET /api/v2/document/field/{fieldId}).
Add recipients to a DRAFT or PENDING document (POST /api/v2/document/recipient/create-many).
Remove an unsigned recipient and its fields (POST /api/v2/document/recipient/delete).
Get a document recipient with its fields (GET /api/v2/document/recipient/{recipientId}).
Reject a PENDING document on behalf of a recipient (POST /api/v2/envelope/recipient/{recipientId}/reject).
Update an unsigned recipient of a DRAFT or PENDING document (POST /api/v2/document/recipient/update).
Complete (sign, approve or mark viewed) or reject as the recipient holding the signing token, filling that recipient's fields.
Open a recipient's signing link by token: the document text, all fields and whether this recipient can act now (marks the link opened).
